attributes.board_name: Maryland State Board of Veterinary Medical Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: AVMA-approved veterinary college courses; AVMA national/regional meetings; MVMA; NAVC, WVC, Central Veterinary Conference, AAHA; other local/state/regional/national courses approved by the Board; online courses allowed
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt from proving CE for 12 months from license issuance when registering for the first time.
rules.carryover: Unused credit hours from one licensing year may be applied to the next year.
rules.alternatives: Conditional renewal for exigent circumstances (e.g. armed services) with a completion plan.
rules.audit_note: Keep attendance records; Board may request verification.

topics.who: Veterinarians applying for or renewing a Maryland CDS permit (prescribing or dispensing CDS)

rules.notes: Annual renewal by June 30. At least 12 h on veterinary medicine skills; max 6 h non-scientific (practice management, communication, regulatory). The 2 h CDS course is required by the Office of Controlled Substances Administration and counts toward the 18 h.
rules.rule_quote: A. Except as provided in §B of this regulation, the Board may not renew a practitioner's license unless that practitioner has earned 18 credit hours of continuing professional education during the: (1) 12 months preceding the beginning of the new licensing year;
